# EVERY1 Movement: how to use the mark

> The published brand standard for the EVERY1 Movement: which mark, on which ground,
> how much room it needs, what never to do, and the tokens a product builds with.
> EVERY1 carries no parent endorsement line and no parent lockup.

## Start here

- [Manifest](https://brand.every1movement.com/ai/manifest.json): the doorway. Every mark with its clear space, minimum size, and files, the full token surface, the measured contrast table, and a SHA-256 on every file named.
- [Tokens](https://brand.every1movement.com/ai/tokens.json): colour, type scale, spacing, radius, elevation, motion, breakpoints, and both themes.
- [Tokens, W3C format](https://brand.every1movement.com/ai/tokens.dtcg.json): the same values as a Design Tokens document, for design tooling and for a build that wants to fail when the brand moves.
- [Stylesheet](https://brand.every1movement.com/assets/brand.css): the tokens and the component layer, linkable directly.
- [brand_check.py](https://brand.every1movement.com/brand_check.py): the mechanical half of the audit, runnable against any file or URL. Use it rather than reimplementing these rules.
- [How to use the mark](https://brand.every1movement.com/): the same standard for people.
- [Messaging standard](https://brand.every1movement.com/messaging/): how EVERY1 speaks. Identity, the mandate, the outside and inside scripts, audiences, voice, and the language we do not use.

## Facts at a glance

Brand version 7.7, updated 2026-08-22.
EVERY1 stands alone. Do not add "A ministry of THE WORD FOR ALL THE WORLD" and do not lock a parent mark to it.
The app icon is the E1 icon, on Midnight, on every surface. The numeral is not the app icon.
Flame never carries text on a light ground. On Midnight it is the text accent, because Ember is 3.25:1 there and fails.
This site answers 404 for paths that do not exist, and publishes a checksum for every file it declares. Verify what you download.
Contact brand@theword.world for a country lockup that is not published yet.
